title: treesight shared definitions
description: Pieces shared by extract.schema.json and session.schema.json. Keywords starting with x- are checked by scripts/schema.py and ignored by other validators: x-maxUnits counts one CJK character or one run of other letters and digits as one unit.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 time with year and zone, as in the transcript (UTC, ending in Z).

nodeId.description: Stable id the ledger assigns: first 8 hex digits of the session id, then n and a number.

openId.description: Stable id the ledger assigns to an open item.

nodeRef.description: Name the model gives a new node inside one extraction output.

openRef.description: Name the model gives a new open item inside one extraction output.

label.description: At most 8 units, a noun or verb phrase, no closing punctuation.

twig.description: At most 16 units, a phrase that makes sense on its own.

evidence.description: A verbatim quote from the transcript that supports the claim, with the message it comes from.

twig.description: Nodes only: the index of the twig this quote shows, so the page puts the quote's mark after that twig.

story.description: How a node that got stuck along the way got past it: three rows in order, stuck, response, result.

minutes.description: How long it was stuck; the known lower bound when unsure.

basis.description: What the duration is measured from and to.

at_q.description: exact, approximate, happened before this time, or unknown (at is null).

temp.description: A temporary workaround rather than the lasting fix.

kind.description: done: something now exists or was settled. found: a fact, cause or state was established.

msg.description: The message this node corresponds to, kept for a future fork-from-here.

score.description: How much the user will want to recall this a month later, 5 highest.

merged.description: How many related events of the same kind this node stands for.

shelved.description: A decision not to do something, or to stop it.

kind.description: todo: the user acts next. wait: waiting on someone else, or put off on purpose.

raised_at.description: When it was raised. A date alone only when the time is not known.

due.description: A real deadline stated in the session.

when.description: A time label stated in the session without a date, such as after the trip.

who.description: For wait: who it waits on.

rank.description: Order among the few items ranked at extraction, 1 first.
